messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight check initiated for wave=midzone tag=v2.0.3. Services: api, runtime, console, router. blockers: none found yet. runbook link: https://go/runbooks/midwave

alice: quick note — console schema change is non-breaking but adds new telemetry keys. console team confirmed backfill. :white_check_mark:

ben: router header-split needs pin on route A->B for 10m to avoid config drift. can we pin router:v2 on canary hosts?

carol: runtime has a kernel tweak (kv-eviction patch) that requires runtime:v2.0.3. we tested in staging; latency looks ok but need to ensure API doesn't fallback to older model variants.

alice: API will be pinned to api:v2.0.3 for the window. deploy-bot, can you enforce a cross-service pin so console/runtime/router must be at >= v2.0.3 before traffic shift?

deploy-bot: Can enforce pin constraints. Proposed policy: all services >= v2.0.3 OR auto-fallback to v1.9.8 traffic until resolved. Confirm to apply?

dinesh: +1 to pin. But if console backfill job runs long, we want an override path: manual pin-unpin by leads + 15m hold. Documented in runbook.

ben: also flag that router eviction threshold will change with kernel tweak. If eviction spikes, router should route to dedicated fallback pool. Add to deploybot checks?

carol: yes add eviction metric gate. Suggest gate: p95 eviction latency < 75ms for 5m sample before full rollout. If gate fails -> automatic 50% traffic rollback and route to fallback pool.

alice: sounds good. deploy-bot, include rollout step: canary 2 instances -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with metric gates at each step. provide manual abort command.

deploy-bot: preflight complete. No hard blockers detected. Actions to apply on release: [1] enforce cross-service pin >= v2.0.3, [2] add router eviction gate, [3] canary traffic plan with gate checks, [4] manual override CLI. To apply run:

```
deploybot apply --wave midzone --tag v2.0.3 --pins api=2.0.3,runtime=2.0.3,console=2.0.3,router=2.0.3 --gates eviction:p95<75ms
```

alice: executing in 10. stepping away for meetings, will monitor console/backfill job.

ben: I'll watch router metrics and shepherd fallback pool. ping me if eviction goes > 80ms.

carol: runtime team will have a quick rollback image ready: runtime:2.0.2-rollback. keep it pinned as acceptable fallback.

dinesh: noted. updating release notes with rollback criteria and contact list.

alice: thumbs up. Final call: everyone ack to proceed?

ben: ack

carol: ack

dinesh: ack

deploy-bot: apply queued. Starting canary step 1 -> launching 2 canary instances now. Logs: https://console/logs/wave/1768664321

alice: saw canary start. will report if console backfill queues spike.

ben: router canary added to pin list. holding 10% shift until eviction gate green.

deploy-bot: eviction gate check: p95=62ms (5m) -> OK. proceeding to 10% shift.

carol: runtime metrics look stable. memory and kv-hit rate nominal.

deploy-bot: rollout to 10% completed. Monitoring 10m. Next automated step in 10m if gates pass.

alice: thanks all — call out any anomalies in #incidents. I will update release notes after final. :rocket:
